title: Our Town
text:
This is my town. There is a big park near my house. Children play there after school. There is also a small library next to the park.

On Sunday, my family goes to the market. The market is near the station. We buy fruit and bread there. Then we have lunch in a café.

questions.text: When does my family go to the market?
Why do the children probably like the park?
options: It is a fun place to play
It is far from their homes

questions.text: What can we guess about the family's Sundays?
options: They spend time together in town
They stay at home and sleep

vocabulary.definition: an area with grass and trees where people can relax or play
a building where people can borrow books
a place where people buy food and other goods
a place where trains or buses stop so people can get on and off

paragraph_translations: To jest moje miasto. Niedaleko mojego domu jest duży park. Dzieci bawią się tam po szkole. Obok parku jest również mała biblioteka.
W niedzielę moja rodzina idzie na targ. Targ jest blisko dworca. Kupujemy tam owoce i chleb. Potem jemy obiad w kawiarni.
